- Emergency Situations","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## C - Emergency Situations

FACT_ID: sec09-F01 | anchor: A01
Emergencies find every driver, so preparation and crash prevention are universal duties with three escape tools: braking, steering, and accelerating [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec09-F02 | anchor: A01
Stopping is the first crash-avoidance instinct, and most new cars carry anti-lock brakes that halt without skidding while preserving steering, so learn your owner's manual, then stomp and hold through normal vibration and clicks while still steering [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec09-F03 | anchor: A01
Cars without anti-lock brakes follow the owner's manual braking procedure instead [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec09-F04 | anchor: A01
Swerving around trouble starts with a two-hand grip, aims where you want to go while dodging traffic, then counter-steers straight to regain control and slow down [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec09-F05 | anchor: A01
Keep both hands on the wheel except for brief driving tasks, and pair braking with steering against roadway obstacles, braking and steering to miss animals that dart out [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec09-F06 | anchor: A01
Sometimes the escape is speed, as when another vehicle threatens from behind or the side [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec09-F07 | anchor: A01
Skids strike from excess speed, panic stops, or lost grip and leave little control, while panicking, brake-stomping, and overcorrecting only deepen the skid toward a fatal crash [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec09-F08 | anchor: A02
Skidding, release both pedals and stare where you want to go, adding steady brake pressure to slow a straight-line slide in an anti-lock car [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec09-F09 | anchor: A02
Without anti-lock brakes, never brake hard since locked wheels worsen skids; slow the car with gentle brake pumps instead [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec09-F10 | anchor: A02
In a sideways skid, steer toward the sliding rear to realign the nose, then unwind promptly as the car straightens to block a counter-skid [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec09-F11 | anchor: A02
Keep seesawing the wheel until the skid fully releases, since the steering wheel outranks every other skid control [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec09-F12 | anchor: A02
Off the pavement edge, refuse panic yanks back up; slow gradually and, when safe, turn briskly back on [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec09-F13 | anchor: A02
After any collision, stop at or near the scene, stay until the officer finishes questioning, and under Kentucky law shift non-injury wrecks to the shoulder per KRS one hundred eighty-nine point five eight zero, subsection one, paragraph b [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec09-F14 | anchor: A02
Log every operator's name, address, and license number, each car's plate, VIN, make, model, and year, each insurer's name and phone, a damage list with photos, and exactly what happened just before and after impact [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec09-F15 | anchor: A02
For parked-car strikes, hunt the owner or leave a visible note bearing your name, address, license and plate numbers, plus the date and time [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec09-F16 | anchor: A02
Property damage over $500 without a police investigation demands a written report to the Kentucky State Police within 10 days of the crash [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec09-F17 | anchor: A03
File the Civilian Traffic Collision report electronically at https://kspportal.ky.gov/CivilianCollisionReporting/ or by mail to Kentucky State Police, 1266 Louisville Road, Frankfort, KY 40601, skipping the form when an officer investigated [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-F18 | anchor: A03
Aid the injured with prompt proper care, summon medics and troopers with a precise location, move victims only to save a life, otherwise await the ambulance while blanketing them warm [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-F19 | anchor: A03
Kentucky law orders every involved operator to stop at once, size up injuries and damage, and render reasonable aid including carrying or arranging transport for treatment when plainly needed or requested [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-F20 | anchor: A03
Honor the owner's manual service schedule to head off failures, watch warning lamps, and never drive under a brake warning [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-F21 | anchor: A03
Brakeless while rolling, drag the parking brake slowly against rear-wheel lockup and skid, poised to release if the tail steps out [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-F22 | anchor: A03
If the parking brake fails too, kill the engine, coast to a safe off-road stop, and never drive on without working brakes [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-F23 | anchor: A03
Blowouts vent tires instantly, yanking front-tire cars hard toward the burst side while rear-tire cars wobble, shake, and drift that way [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-F24 | anchor: A03
On a blowout, clamp the wheel straight, lift off the gas, and shun the brake, letting the car coast down or braking only feather-light [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-F25 | anchor: A04
Never halt on the roadway when avoidable; limp to a safe shoulder, flash the hazards, and fit a fresh tire [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec09-F26 | anchor: A04
Dead engine rolling, muscle the heavy-but-turnable wheel, pick an escape path, and brake steadily rather than hard while easing off the road [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec09-F27 | anchor: A04
Halted, retry the starter, and on failure raise the hood, light the flashers, and call for help [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec09-F28 | anchor: A04
For a runaway accelerator, switch the engine off, grab neutral, find an escape path, steer smooth, brake soft, pull clear, and fix the pedal before driving again [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec09-F29 | anchor: A04
Breakdowns kill visibility, so park fully off to the right when possible or where distant drivers can spot you, never just past a crest or bend, flashing hazards with the hood raised [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec09-F30 | anchor: A04
Plant warning flares 200 to 300 feet behind the disabled car to buy lane-change time, and phone authorities, whose numbers many roadways post [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0066]
